title: fix(plugin-charts): place the x axis by the spec `xAxis.position`, and refuse a side it cannot take (objectui#10587)
body:
Fixes #10587
Clause-②: no — the renderer begins honouring a key the spec already declares; no export, schema or accept set moves.

## What changed

`xAxis.position` is declared on `@objectstack/spec`'s `ChartAxisSchema` (which `ChartSchema.xAxis` takes by reference) and, since objectui#10516, kept by `normalizeChartSchema`. No axis read it. This change makes the renderer read it, in `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` only.

**The mapping** (`placeXAxis`, stated in its doc comment):

| Family | How the spec `xAxis` is drawn | Sides it takes | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| bar, line, area, combo | recharts `XAxis` (category band) across the plot | `top` / `bottom` → `orientation` | bottom |
| scatter | recharts `XAxis type="number"` across the plot | `top` / `bottom` → `orientation` | bottom |
| horizontal-bar | recharts `YAxis type="category"` down the plot | `left` / `right` → `orientation` | left |

Horizontal-bar reading, decided by what the branch already does: it swaps the axis roles (`yAxisSpecProps(primaryY)` configures its number `XAxis`, and `xTickFormatter`, built from `xAxis.format`, formats its category `YAxis`). So the `xAxis` object already follows the categories there, and `position` follows them too. Reading it as "the horizontal axis" would split one axis object across two drawn axes.

**A side the axis cannot take** (`left` / `right` across the plot; `top` / `bottom` on horizontal-bar) is refused, loudly, in the file's existing partial-answer channel: the chart still draws, with the axis at its default side, and `ChartFootnote` adds a `p role="note" data-chart-note="x-axis-position"` naming `xAxis.position`, the value, and the side the axis was drawn on. Not a `ChartRefusal` (that replaces the whole tile and would blank a chart that plots correctly over one presentation key), and no console warning, for the reason the other notes give: the sentence already names the key and the value. No new diagnostic channel; no schema narrowing (`ChartAxisSchema` is shared by both axes and is the spec's).

**A top axis** mirrors the bottom layout: the title uses `insideTop` (the `insideBottom` layout mirrored) and rotated tick labels slant `35` instead of `-35`, so both stay on the far side of the axis from the plot.

A chart that declares no `position` emits no `orientation` prop and no note; the bottom / no-position controls below pin that.

Docs: the `position` row of `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx` now states the x-axis reading and, for `yAxis`, points at objectui#10654 (round 2, below). Changesets: `.changeset/10587-xaxis-position.md` (`'@object-ui/plugin-charts': patch`); `.changeset/10516-xaxis-presentation-gate.md` keeps its "at this change no renderer reads it" sentence and gains a dated note pointing here (front matter md5 `efdd05dcdeaee331682c8032a97b743b` before and after).

## Measured on the base (`651632062`)

`ChartRenderer` with `xAxis: { field: 'month', position: 'top' }` (and `left`) on bar, line, area, combo, horizontal-bar and scatter: every category tick label carried `orientation="bottom"` (horizontal-bar: `left`), identical to the no-position render, and no note. The x axis ignored the key everywhere.

## Pins: `ChartRenderer.xAxisPosition-10587.test.tsx` (29 tests, through `ChartRenderer`, reading the rendered tick `orientation`)

- head `904b074ac`: `Tests  29 passed (29)`
- base implementation swapped in (`AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` blob `364cc5f5` = the base blob, restored to the head blob afterwards and `git diff HEAD` empty): `Tests  18 failed | 11 passed`. The 18 red are every non-control pin; the 11 green are exactly the controls (`bottom` / no position on bar, line, area, scatter; `left` / no position on horizontal-bar; the bottom title and bottom rotation controls).

## Round 2 (head `ef357e489`)

Contract review FAIL on one published sentence: the docs row opened with the unscoped "The side of the chart the axis belongs to.", which also covered `yAxis`, where `position` does not reliably set the side. Two edits, one commit:

- **Docs row.** The Effect cell of the `position` row keeps the x-axis text and now ends: "On `yAxis` it does not yet reliably set the side the axis is drawn on (objectui#10654, the y-side twin of objectui#10587)." It points at the card instead of restating per-family readings. Those readings are objectui#10654's to change, and a copy in published docs would go false when that card lands (AGENTS.md #9). A first draft, "On `yAxis` it is not yet honoured", was measured false and not landed. An authored `chartType: 'combo'` with a lone `yAxis` entry at `position: 'right'` and no `series` draws its data on a right-hand axis: the normalizer derives the series from the y entries and binds that one to the right. With `position: 'left'` or no position the same chart draws on the left.
- **Comment.** The comment above `categoriesRunDown` no longer claims a horizontal-bar can become a combo. `comboBaseFamily` never widens a horizontal-bar, so one with mixed series stays horizontal and keeps the `left` / `right` reading. Comment only; no code change.

Clause check before commit: a throwaway jsdom probe through `ChartRenderer` at `904b074ac` (61 plus 27 schemas, all runs passed, probe files deleted). ## Acceptance notes

- NOT MEASURED: a real-browser screenshot of a top axis. The geometry claims (title above the tick labels, labels slanting away from the plot) are read from the jsdom render, whose text metrics are zero; the top title layout is the exact mirror of the shipped bottom one (`insideTop` vs `insideBottom`, same offset), so its spacing to the ticks is the bottom axis's.
- Non-cartesian families (pie, donut, funnel, radar, treemap, sankey) read no `xAxis` key at all, `position` included; unchanged.
- Out of scope, carded by the seat and not addressed here: the y side of `position` is objectui#10654 (a lone right-hand `yAxis` entry on bar draws on the left, `top` / `bottom` on a y entry pass in silence, and the round-2 findings: a horizontal-bar with two y entries drops bars, and a derived series follows a first entry's `right` to the right-hand axis); the horizontal-bar axis titles (`xAxis.title` not drawn, the `yAxis` title laid out as a vertical-axis title on the horizontal value axis) are objectui#10655.
- `check-changeset-overwrite` reports the dated-note edit to `.changeset/10516-xaxis-presentation-gate.md`; that is its case 2 (a deliberate correction), report-only.
- `check-changeset-claims` asks for a re-read of `.changeset/7546-chart-series-keys-declared.md`, which names `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`: that paragraph is about series keys and is still true.
